results.title: Timeline of the stunning fall of powerful Nvidia CEO Jensen Huang - ABC News
results.content:
Nov. 11, 2026 -- The New York Times reports that Huang allegedly had a second extramarital relationship with an Nvidia executive who reports to him. The Wall Street Journal reports that Nvidia's Board of Directors is reportedly planning to oust Jensen Huang as the company's CEO. [...] Nov. 12, 2026 -- Nvidia announces Jensen Huang has resigned as the company's CEO and that Colette Kress, executive vice president and CFO of Nvidia, has been appointed the company's interim CEO as the board initiates a search for a permanent replacement for Huang.

In a Bloomberg interview from mid-October, Huang was vague about succession plans. "I'm really hoping that the next CEO of the company is already at the company, but 20 years from now, I hope I stay healthy and I hope I continue to earn my keep." [...] Jensen Huang, CEO of the chipmaking juggernaut Nvidia, is stepping down.

The decision comes days after the company took the extraordinary step of launching an investigation following news reports alleging that Huang had had an extramarital affair with one of the company's clients, who U.S. intelligence officials concluded had been recruited by China's top spy agency, according to the New York Times. NPR has not independently confirmed those reports.

message.content:
## Recent developments
- **CEO Transition and Resignation:** Co-founder and long-time CEO Jensen Huang resigned on November 12, 2026, following an internal investigation and intense scrutiny regarding reports of a personal relationship linked to foreign intelligence concerns [NVIDIA Announces CEO Transition, NPR]. 
- **Interim Leadership:** Executive Vice President and CFO Colette Kress was appointed interim CEO, while Harvey C. Jones was named the first-ever Chair of the Board as the board initiates a search for a permanent CEO [NVIDIA Announces CEO Transition, ABC News].
- **Strategic Collaborations:** Prior to the leadership shakeup, NVIDIA announced a partnership with Rebellions and SK Telecom in early November 2026 to advance sovereign AI infrastructure utilizing NVIDIA NVLink Fusion [NVIDIA Announces CEO Transition].
- **Upcoming Financials:** The company is preparing for its upcoming third-quarter financial results conference call, which will be the first major corporate update under interim leadership [NVIDIA Announces CEO Transition].

## Talking points
- **Leadership Continuity:** Reassure stakeholders about the stability of the executive team, emphasizing Colette Kress’s extensive financial and operational leadership experience as interim CEO.
- **Strategic Execution:** Reiterate that NVIDIA’s core technology roadmap, product cycles (such as advanced GPUs and NVLink Fusion infrastructure), and key partnerships remain entirely on track despite the leadership change.
- **Corporate Governance:** Address any board-level measures implemented following the transition, highlighting the separation of roles with Harvey C. Jones taking on the newly created Chair of the Board position.

## Open questions
- What is the expected timeline and criteria for the board to find a permanent CEO?
- Are there any operational or strategic shifts anticipated under the interim leadership of Colette Kress ahead of the upcoming Q3 earnings call?
- How will the recent leadership transition affect ongoing international partnerships and sovereign AI infrastructure initiatives, particularly in regions like Asia-Pacific?

## Sources
- [NVIDIA Announces CEO Transition](https://nvidianews.nvidia.com/news/nvidia-announces-ceo-transition)
- [Nvidia scandal: What’s next for the US tech company? | Al Jazeera](https://www.aljazeera.com/news/2026/11/13/nvidia-scandal-whats-next-for-the-us-tech-company)
- [Timeline of the stunning fall of powerful Nvidia CEO Jensen Huang - ABC News](https://abcnews.com/Business/timeline-stunning-fall-powerful-nvidia-ceo-jensen-huang/story?id=138041659)
- [Nvidia launches investigation into CEO’s alleged relationship with Chinese spy - NPR](https://www.npr.org/2026/11/08/nx-s1-6034036/nvidia-launches-investigation-into-ceos-alleged-relationship-with-chinese-spy)
- [Nvidia board ousts CEO Jensen Huang amid alleged spy scandal - NPR](https://www.npr.org/2026/11/12/nx-s1-6037833/jensen-huang-nvidia-stepped-down)
